$comment: Hardware frame-budget preset set: one preset per render shape whose GPU cost the Y-flip / blur / Dual-FBO work changes. Read by scripts/benchmark_presets_wasm.mjs via PROJECTM_BENCH_MANIFEST in .github/workflows/graphics_perf_bench.yml. The flip counts are pinned by tests/libprojectM/PerfGpuStageTest.cpp. See docs/GRAPHICS_BENCHMARK_HARNESS.md "Hardware baseline".

audioBench.comment: Synthetic 120 BPM PCM, so audio-reactive stages do real work.

presets.label: empty baseline
presets.comment: Default warp, no composite shader: the fixed per-frame cost every preset pays.

presets.label: no composite shader (old-school)
presets.comment: Two Y-flips per frame: before the composite and the third flip after it.

presets.label: custom warp + composite shader
presets.comment: Two Y-flips: the pre-warp flip sampler_main needs, and the pre-composite flip.

presets.label: composite shader sampling blur1-3
presets.comment: Full blur chain every frame, one Y-flip (pre-composite).

presets.label: Dual-FBO soft cut (milk012 -> milk015)
presets.comment: Samples only frames rendered while a crossfade from the previous entry is blending: both presets render into the Dual-FBO pair and the compositor presents them.
